parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstanceInfo](~~140857~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: PullinStatus
parameters.description:
The status of traffic redirection. Valid values:

*   **on**
*   **off**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi modify-hybrid-cloud-sdk-pullin-status --instance-id waf-cn-7pp2le00001 --pullin-status on --mid b3dbc5153317c79d8ca9f9000ea --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi ModifyHybridCloudSdkPullinStatus --region cn-hangzhou --PullinStatus on --InstanceId 'waf-cn-7pp2le00001' --Mid b3dbc5153317c79d8ca9f9000ea
